description: Ranked MCP servers from the latest MCP Morning snapshot. list=most_used (weekly downloads + GitHub stars/forks), rising (week-over-week download growth; requires 25 stars or 1,000 prior-week downloads), or new (repo created in the last 30 days). Optional language (GitHub primary language) and category (database, browser, files, search, dev, comms, cloud, ai, commerce, marketing, memory, finance). limit≤25, paginate with offset. Returns snapshot date and item page URLs. Popularity only — MCP Morning does not run or test servers.

category.description: Job category slug or label: database (Databases & data), browser (Browser & web scraping), files (Files & documents), search (Search & knowledge), dev (Dev tools & GitHub), comms (Messaging & collaboration), cloud (Cloud & infrastructure), ai (AI models & media), commerce (Payments & commerce), marketing (Marketing & SEO), memory (Memory & context), finance (Finance & crypto).

language.description: Filter by GitHub primary language, e.g. TypeScript or Python.

list.description: Ranking to return: most_used, rising, or new.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination.

name: top_servers
